# The initial feature model

<!-- FIXME: update this text only mentioning that this is the initial model from the top-down approach -->
Before the generalisation, the model was derived top-down from a single tool: Mono2Micro's identification pipeline. This initial version has <b>47</b> features and <b>0</b> cross-tree constraints, rooted at <i>Monolith Microservices Identification</i>. It is published so the two can be compared — the difference is what the bottom-up phase, driven by the meta-review and the tool mappings, actually added.
